method: Same immutable archived real Blueprints, one query preparation per ship, sequential trials, Node --expose-gc; no hull regeneration included. p95 empirical nearest rank, N=1 or3 is not a stable tail estimate. Area is sum of local circular footprints, NOT union or removed material area.
